articles.title: Microsoft found malware that hijacks crypto wallets and spreads through USB sticks
articles.snippet: The software intercepts shortcut files and directs them to install a worm that harvests private keys from the Windows clipboard and inserts its own destination wallet addresses when it detects a transfer.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation loses another key leader as co-executive director Hsiao-Wei Wang resigns
articles.snippet: Wang's departure follows the resignation of fellow co-executive director Tomasz Stańczak and marks the latest in a string of high-profile exits at the EF.

articles.title: Philippine SEC signals readiness for RWA tokenization
articles.snippet: Philippine SEC Commissioner Rogelio Quevedo told Cointelegraph that tokenized assets could give Filipinos more legitimate investment options while helping steer them away from scams.

articles.title: Amazon Won't Release Sam Altman Film 'Artificial' Following $50 Billion OpenAI Investment
articles.snippet: Amazon is pulling out of "Artificial," a film about Sam Altman's brief ouster from OpenAI, not long after investing $50 billion in the firm.

articles.title: Franklin Templeton Files for ETFs That Funnel Stock Dividends Into Bitcoin
articles.snippet: The asset manager's two proposed "Bitcoin DRIP" funds would hold U.S. stocks and reinvest dividends into Bitcoin, a novel ETF structure.
